curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that every applicant is vision-tested, what wearing lenses does to the license, and what happens after a failed vision test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per vision rule, with the lens restriction and the eye doctor form kept apart.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that describes an applicant's eyesight and asks what follows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the knowledge test format, the three attempts, the minor retake wait, the renewal eLearning option, when testing opens, and the ban on testing aids.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each knowledge test rule; contrast cards for attempts versus retake wait and for eLearning versus the original test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the attempt count, the wait days and who may use eLearning.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover who takes the drive test, how the examiner may give stacked instructions, booking, and the minor retake wait, then set the three tests side by side.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each drive test rule; a contrast card separating the vision, knowledge and drive tests.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a test or a wait and asks which applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the papers, the licensed companion, the safe insured registered vehicle and the rental car conditions needed on test day.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per item to bring; a contrast card grouping them into four categories.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that describes a test-day arrival and asks what is missing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk around the test vehicle: window and windshield, mirrors, brake lights, tires, brake pedal and horn, then the parking brake, arm signals, wipers and belts you must demonstrate.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each vehicle requirement; contrast cards for the numeric thresholds and for the three demonstrations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the mirror count, tread depth, pedal clearance and horn distance.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who may ride along, the interpreter limit, the recording ban, and which vehicle technology is banned or allowed during the test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each conduct rule; contrast cards for interpreters versus the examiner and assistance versus safety technology.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a passenger, device or feature and asks whether it is allowed.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec03-m01..sec03-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
